TLCK inhibits initiation of protein synthesis in reticulocytes more than in other cell types.
TLCK, a proteinase inhibitor, inhibits the initiation of translation of α globin mRNA more than β globin mRNA in rabbit reticulocyte lysates.

(i) TLCK inhibits initiation of translation in rabbit reticulocyte lysates, but the inhibition of β chain synthesis is less than that of α chain; and (ii) TLCK does not inhibit initiation of translation on the globin mRNAs in vitro, but the inhibition is greater for the α chain mRNA.
